description: State Road reserve is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. The State Road reserve identifies land parcels on which State Roads infrastructure is built or surrounds the road network. These areas are reserved for & used as road corridors. These areas are either described by volume and folio reference, or mapped as a buffer to road centre lines. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are LAND-Cadastre, TRANSPORTATION-Land. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
